neighbours.label: Comparing an object's size to a familiar thing: Russian 'размером с …' ('the size of a …') and 'big/large enough to fit …', firing on ' с' or ' fit'; the same objects described without a size comparison stay quiet.
fire: С неба падал град размером с куриное яйцо.
Рыбак поймал щуку размером с крокодила.
В саду вырос кабачок размером с подушку.
На рынке продавали яблоки размером с кулак.
The hole in the fence was big enough to fit a dog.
Her handbag is large enough to fit a laptop.
The cave was wide enough to fit three tents.
The pocket is deep enough to fit a phone.
quiet: С неба падал сильный град весь вечер.
Рыбак поймал большую щуку в озере.
The hole in the fence was repaired last week.
Her handbag is made of brown leather.
The cave was dark and damp inside.
The pocket has a zip and a small button.

short: size comparison ('размером с', 'big enough to fit')
notes: Card: ' like' x6, ' a' x5, Russian ' с' x2 (размером с воздушные шарики), ' two', ' of' (the size of houses), ' fit' (big enough to fit a Skoal can); output promotes ' size', ' small', ' larger'. Exploratory probe: 'размером с' 0.82, 'big enough to fit' 0.57, but English 'the size of golf balls' only 0.08, so the label keeps to the two working forms.
